senses.gloss: the act of traveling through or studying something unknown

definition_translations.zh_TW: 穿越或研究未知事物的探索行為
definition_translations.ja_JP: 未知の場所を移動するか、または研究する行為、探索

senses.gloss: careful examination of an idea or subject
senses.example: The proposal includes an exploration of new sales channels.

definition_translations.ja_JP: アイデアや主題の詳細な調査

translations.th_TH: การสำรวจทั่วไป
